name: decide_discount
description: Brief the manager on one discount request, take approve, counter-offer or reject, read it back and record it.

get_approval_brief.description: Load the discount request this call is about. Call it first.

record_approval_decision.description: Record the manager's confirmed decision: approve, counter (with approved_pct) or reject.

parameters.name: approved_pct
parameters.description: Only for counter: the offered percentage

report_call_outcome.description: Report that the call ends without a decision (no_answer, busy, voicemail or failed).

on_voicemail_detected.description: Trigger OnVoicemailDetected: leave the safe line, report voicemail, end the call.

on_call_end.description: Trigger OnEnd: report failed when the call ends without a decision.
